units.text: ok its 3:02 and nobody from the chat has shown up. this is so cringe
units.name: PRIYA
paren: checking her phone, then the door

units.name: JAYDEN
paren: sliding into the booth, hood up

units.text: you're my HALF BROTHER?? you told me you were 19 and lived in Denver
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: I said I was nineteen in the chat because everybody there was older okay
units.name: JAYDEN
paren: wincing as a waiter drops a tray nearby

units.text: Wait wait dont, I'm literally outside the window, look left
units.name: MOONBEAM

units.text: omg that's Moonbeam?? they're like twelve??
units.name: PRIYA
paren: turning, a dog on the sidewalk pulling its owner past the glass

units.text: Fifteen. And they/them thank you. Hi. Please dont yell I brought snacks
units.name: MOONBEAM
paren: they push through the door, backpack sliding off one shoulder

units.name: PRIYA
paren: shouting, two teenagers at the next table turning to stare

units.text: Sorry im late guys the bus driver was a nightmare, wait. Why is everyone here a kid
units.name: DEVON

units.text: because we are ALL kids Devon. every single one of us
units.name: PRIYA
paren: laughing despite herself, wiping her eyes

units.text: Ok so group chat is real now. Who's getting the garlic knots
units.name: MOONBEAM
paren: sitting, pushing the snacks to the middle of the table

units.name: JAYDEN
paren: grinning, finally pulling his hood down
